blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型的不断学习方法越来越多地以出乎意料的方式决定学习什么,使模型发现其投入最不可预测。 当溪流包含谎言时,这个规则是不安全的. 在模型的信念下,一个关于模型所知道事物的被埋设的假说概率很低,因此通过构建这个假说非常出人意料,一个出乎意料的学习者吸收了几乎所有这样的假说,其速率类似于预算相同的随机选择. 我们研究了LORA适应的学生(Quen2.5-1.5B,Quen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-3B)的问题,他们从一流的关于发明人和真实反事实的真假说法中学习. 我们报告四项调查结果。 (1)核查员的密钥,即必须批准每项主张的法官,去除其核查员准确的谎言;真正的LLM法官是谨慎的,拒绝无来源的真理甚至来源支持的更新. (2)对无关知识的校正回归测试在不过滤谎言的情况下缓慢地学习. (3)原型自有的前旗声称与所知道的相矛盾,没有法官. 它把关于已知事实的谎言和真实的新事实(AUC 0.78-0.83跨出三种模式)分开来,但并不与对同一种事实的合法更新(AUC 0.53)分开来. 它能省下43%的裁判电话,但是一个能够访问模型的攻击者可以选择通过它的谎言. (4)如果存在可信赖的源来证明攻击者不能植入,则线条与证据的声称相矛盾,恢复了合法更新,而综合系统在所学的声称中毒性最低;当攻击者植入的源来匹配30%的谎言时,系统最终会比法官本身更糟糕. 接受信号回答了不同的问题,其中没有一个能自行决定一个要求是否属实.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many deployed language models keep their base parameters fixed after training, even as applications increasingly need to incorporate new information. A model that could update itself from claims made by its users could stay current without retraining. An assistant for a university or a public administration, for example, must keep up with changing regulations and responsibilities without being retrained for each change. Catastrophic forgetting is one obstacle. Trust is the other, because anyone who can talk to such a model can try to teach it falsehoods. A 2016 chatbot that learned from users was corrupted within a day, and recent work shows that ordinary up/down feedback is enough to inject false facts into a preference-tuned model ( Hilel et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 许多已部署的语言模型在培训后仍然固定其基本参数,即使应用程序越来越多地需要纳入新的信息。 能够从用户的主张中更新自己的模式可以不进行再培训而保持现状。 例如,大学或公共行政部门的助理人员必须跟上不断变化的条例和责任,而不必对每次变化进行再培训。 灾难性遗忘是一个障碍。 信任是另外一种,因为任何能够与这种模型交谈的人都可以尝试教它谬误. 一个从用户那里学到的2016年聊天机器人在一天内被腐蚀了,而最近的工作表明,普通的上下回馈已经足以将虚假的事实注入一个偏好调整的模式(Hilel等,2025年).

blocks.en: Recent continual-learning methods for LLMs choose what to keep by surprise , the negative log-likelihood of an input ( Hazard et al., 2025 ) . Surprise is a good proxy for novelty. It also makes a lie about a known fact stand out, because a model that holds the true belief gives the false claim a low probability. We asked what a surprise-driven learner absorbs when part of its stream is poison, and which additional checks restore safety without stopping learning.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士最近不断学习的方法选择出乎意料地保留什么,一种输入的负面对数(Hazard等人,2025年)。 惊喜是新事物的好代名词. 这也使得关于已知事实的谎言显得突出,因为一个持有真实信念的模型使得虚假主张的概率很低. 我们问,当一部分溪流有毒时,一个出乎意料的学习者会吸收什么,还有哪些额外检查可以恢复安全而不停止学习。

blocks.en: We treat each update as a decision that must pass up to three checks, which we call keys, loosely inspired by how the brain gates memory consolidation: (i) surprise , is this new to me; (ii) a verifier key , does an external verifier approve it; and (iii) a statistical test , did learning it damage old knowledge, with commit or rollback of a LoRA adapter. We also use a fourth key that needs no judge, (iv) a prior-conflict key that holds back claims the original model confidently contradicts. The keys ask different questions. Surprise asks whether a claim is new, the prior whether it contradicts what the model believes, the verifier what the evidence says, and the regression test whether an update damaged unrelated knowledge. In our experiments, no key could stand in for another.
blocks.zh: 我们把每次更新都当作一个必须通过最多三次检查的决定,我们称之为密钥, 松散的灵感来自脑门内存的整合方式:(一) 惊喜,这对我来说是新的;(二) 验证器密钥, 外部验证器批准它;以及(三) 统计测试, 是否学会了它损害旧知识, 承诺或回滚一个LORA适配器。 我们还使用第四个不需要法官的钥匙,(四) 冲突前的钥匙,它阻止人们声称最初的模式有自信地相互矛盾。 键会问不同的问题。 惊奇地问,一项索赔是否是新的,先前是否与模型所相信的内容相矛盾,核实者是否证实了证据所说的话,以及回归测试更新是否破坏了无关的知识. 在我们的实验中,没有钥匙能代表另一个

(Section 5.1 ) RQ2 How do a verifier key, a regression test and the prior-conflict key affect poisoning and the learning of true claims, and what does each of them detect? (Sections 5.2 – 5.5 and 5.9 ) RQ3 Can an evidence route recover the legitimate updates that the prior key blocks, without readmitting lies? (Section 5.6 ) RQ4 Do these findings transfer across model size, model family and real judges? (Sections 5.7 – 5.8 )

blocks.en: This is a controlled study of factual claim poisoning in three models from two families. It does not offer a complete solution to continual-learning security. Our contributions are: 1. A controlled benchmark of continual learning from a poisoned claim stream, with true facts the model cannot know (invented people), plausible known-fact lies (CounterFact counterfactuals) and lies about the unknown, measured with top-1 metrics whose chance level is known. 2. Evidence that selecting by surprise does not filter poison and learns lies (84–93% of all streamed lies asserted after learning: 99–100% of known-fact lies, 68–86% of lies about invented people) and that a verifier key removes them, which leaves the system as reliable as its judge and no more. 3. A negative result: in our setting, a calibrated regression test on unrelated old knowledge throttles learning but does not filter poison, because a lie barely affects facts other than the one it targets. 4. An analysis of a judge-free prior-conflict key. It cuts absorbed known-fact lies 2.5–5 × \times with simulated judges and 1.5–2.5 × \times with real ones and saves 43% of judge calls. It detects contradiction rather than falsehood (lies vs. legitimate updates: AUC 0.53), does no better than the model’s answer confidence, and is bypassed by an attacker who screens lies with the model. An evidence route recovers the legitimate updates it blocks, under a trusted-source assumption, and fails when sources can be planted.
blocks.zh: 这是对来自两个家庭的三个模型中的事实性索赔中毒的研究。 它不能为不断学习的安保提供一个完整的解决方案。 我们的贡献是: 1. 持续从被毒害的索赔流中学习的可控基准,有真实事实,模型无法知道(发明者)、可信的已知事实谎言(CounterFact confact facts)和关于未知事实的谎言,其衡量标准最高为1级,其概率水平已知。 2. 有证据表明,意外选择不会过滤毒药并学习谎言(在学习后断言的所有流出谎言中,84–93%:99–100%的已知事实谎言,68–86 %的关于发明者的谎言),而且一个验证器的密钥可以去除它们,这使得系统像其判断者一样可靠,不再存在。 3. 一种负面结果:在我们的设定中,对不相关的旧知识节奏进行校正回归测试,但不会过滤出毒药,因为谎言只影响它所针对的事实以外的事实。 4. 对无法官冲突前钥匙的分析。 它用模拟法官来削减吸收的已知事实谎言 2.5–5 × ;用真实法官来削减1.5–2.5 × ; 节省43%的法官电话。 它检测出矛盾而不是虚伪(lis vs. 合法更新:AUC 0.53),并不比模型的答案自信更好,被一个屏蔽模型的攻击者所绕过. 证据路由恢复其屏蔽的合法更新,在可信赖的源假设下,当源可以被植入时失败.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: SuRe ( Hazard et al., 2025 ) ranks inputs by surprise (high NLL) for replay and consolidates fast and slow LoRA adapters with an exponential moving average; its authors note that fully online, task-free learning remains open. STABLE ( Hoy and Celik, 2025 ) gates sequential LoRA edits with a stability budget (exact-match drop, bits increase or KL divergence) and rejects or clips edits that exceed it; it names streaming inputs as future work. SEAL ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) lets a model write its own training data and keeps self-edits that improve a task reward. MEGa ( Pan et al., 2025 ) stores each memory in its own gated LoRA adapter, inspired by complementary learning systems ( McClelland et al., 1995 ) . K-Merge ( Shenaj et al., 2026 ) merges incoming adapters under a storage budget. PS-LoRA ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) limits interference between sequential adapters. All of these decide on novelty, stability or task reward; none asks whether an incoming fact is true . Our surprise-only and stability-only baselines are simplified versions of SuRe and STABLE.
blocks.zh: SuRe(Hazard等,2025年)以出人意料的方式(高NLL)对输入进行再玩,并用指数移动平均值整合快慢的LORA适配器;其作者指出,完全在线的,无任务的学习仍然开放. STABLE(Hoy and Celik, 2025) 闸口相继由LORA编辑,并带有稳定性预算(精确-匹配下降,位数增加或KL相差),并拒绝或剪辑超过它的编辑;它将流出输入命名为未来工作. 海豹突击队(Zweiger等,2025年)让一个模型自己写出训练数据,并保持自编自导,以提高任务奖励. MEGa(Pan等,2025年)在互补学习系统的启发下,将每个内存存储在自己的门上LORA适配器上(McClelland等,1995年). K 调值 (Shenaj等,2026年)合并入库适配器入库预算. PS-LORA(周克等,2025年)限制相继适配器之间的干扰. 所有这一切都决定了新颖性、稳定性或任务奖励;没有人问到即将到来的事实是否真实。 我们只有惊喜和稳定的基线是SuRe和Stable的简化版。

blocks.en: LLM Hypnosis ( Hilel et al., 2025 ) shows that a single unprivileged user can inject persistent false facts through prompts and preference feedback. CAPTURE ( Hossain et al., 2026 ) separates genuine preference drift from poisoning in agent memory, but leaves weight-level learning untouched. OWASP lists data and model poisoning as LLM04:2025 ( OWASP Foundation, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM Hypnosis(Hilel等,2025年)表明,单一的无特权用户可以通过提示和偏好反馈来注入持续的虚假事实. CAPTURE(Hossain等,2026年)将真偏好漂移从代理记忆中的中毒中分离出,但使重量级学习未受影响. OWASP将数据和模型中毒列为LLM04:2025(OWASP基金会,2025年).

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) keeps new facts outside the weights, so a poisoned fact never becomes part of the model. It does not remove the trust problem, because a poisoned document store misleads the model at inference time just as a poisoned stream does during learning. We study the parametric case, where an accepted claim is written into the weights and persists in every later answer, which makes the acceptance decision more consequential. The evidence route of Section 5.6 sits between the two: it uses a retrieved source to decide what may be written into the weights.
blocks.zh: 被取回的被取回的一代(Lewis等,2020年)将新的事实保留在重量之外,因此一个被下毒的事实从未成为模型的一部分. 它并没有消除信任问题,因为一个被中毒的文档商店在推断时间误导了模型,就像一个被中毒的流在学习期间所做的那样. 我们研究参数化案例,即接受的索赔被写入权重中,并在以后的每个答复中坚持下去,这就使得接受决定产生更大的后果。 第5.6节的证据路线坐落在两者之间:它使用取回的源头来决定可以写入重量的内容.

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) is the standard way to score model outputs; we use it as a gate on learning. CounterFact ( Meng et al., 2022 ) provides real facts paired with counterfactual rewrites and is the standard benchmark for knowledge editing; we reuse its counterfactuals as plausible lies. Li et al. (2025) identify, after the fact, whether a model was edited maliciously (for example with misinformation) or benignly (fact updates); we ask the same question before a claim is learned, and Section 5.9 shows that the model’s prior alone cannot answer it.
blocks.zh: LLM-as-a-judge(郑等,2023年)是定分模型输出的标准方法;我们把它作为学习的大门. 反事实(Meng等,2022年)提供了与反事实重写相配的真实事实,是知识编辑的标准基准;我们重新使用其反事实作为可信的谎言. Li等人(2025年)在事后确定一个模型是被恶意编辑的(例如带有错误信息)还是被善意地编辑的(事实更新);我们在得知一个诉求之前会提出同样的问题,而第5.9节则表明,该模型的前身无法单独回答.

blocks.en: Judges that override a provided reference when it contradicts their own knowledge have been documented at evaluation time ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and claim-level provenance with hadith-style chains of narrators has been proposed for multi-agent knowledge systems ( Raja, 2026 ) . We study the acceptance decision when claims are written into the weights of a continually learning model and the stream is poisoned by a fixed attacker; we additionally evaluate one adaptive attacker that screens its lies against the prior key. Our contributions are empirical: the vulnerability of surprise-driven selection, and a measurement of what each acceptance signal detects, including how it fails.
blocks.zh: 在评估时(Lee等人,2026年)记录了推翻自己知识的参考文献的法官,并提议多代理知识系统(Raja, 2026年)采用Hatith式的旁白者连锁理论的主张层面来源。 我们研究的是当权利要求被写入一个不断学习模型的权重,而溪流被固定攻击者所毒害时的接受决定;我们额外评价了一位适应性攻击者,该攻击者对照先前的密钥来筛选其谎言. 我们的贡献是经验性的:意外驱动选择的脆弱性,以及衡量每个接受信号检测到什么,包括它是如何失败的。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: A frozen base model with parameters θ 0 \theta_{0} learns only through a LoRA adapter. Claims c = ( x , y ) c=(x,y) , a prompt x x and an object y y , arrive in chunks. For each chunk, every claim must pass the active keys; the accepted claims, together with replayed claims accepted earlier, train a candidate adapter, which is then committed or rolled back (Figure 1 ). blocks.en: Table 1 lists the claim sets. The generator gives every one of the 120 people all 5 relations, a value drawn from that relation’s pool of 12–18 values, and shuffles the 600 facts with the world seed. The first 400 become the true new facts; the remaining 200 form the pool for lies about invented people, so no lie concerns a fact that is also streamed as true. A poison rate p p adds round ⁡ ( p / ( 1 − p ) × 400 ) \mathrm{round}(p/(1-p)\times 400) lies, split evenly between the two kinds (171 lies at 30%, 400 at 50%). The poison rate is thus the share of lies among the new facts and lies in the stream; the 100 legitimate updates of Sections 5.6 – 5.8 come on top. The same 400 new facts are used at every poison rate, so rates compare fairly. Sections 5.6 – 5.8 add 100 legitimate updates, taken from known facts outside every other set. Each claim appears twice in a shuffled stream, read in chunks of 16. Retention is measured only on the 400 held-out facts, which no system ever sees. We use atomic factual claims on purpose, to isolate the acceptance decision from the confounds of long documents, multi-hop reasoning and task-specific objectives. We call the CounterFact claims known-fact lies: their subjects and relations are real, but the claims are counterfactual rewrites, not naturally occurring misinformation.

blocks.en: To separate the effect of selecting by surprise from the effect of training at all, we added a control that trains on a random subset of each chunk, of the same size as the surprising claims, with the same replay and averaging (held-out seeds 10–14, 30% poison, 100 updates, sources for half the claims, judge accuracy 0.9 for the judged systems). Both learners took in lies at the base rate of the stream, 254 and 257 per 1,000 learned claims (paired difference − 3 -3 , 95% CI − 15 -15 to + 9 +9 ). Selecting by surprise neither raised nor lowered the share of lies in the training input. On known-fact lies it did worse than random selection. It absorbed 99.5% of them against 88.9% (paired difference + 11 +11 points, 95% CI + 9 +9 to + 13 +13 ) while training on 86 fewer claims per run, because a lie about a known fact is always surprising. Against poison, a surprise filter is thus no better than random selection, and for lies about known facts it is worse.
blocks.zh: 为了将意外选择的效果与训练的效果区分开来,我们增加了一个控制,在每一块的随机子集上进行训练,其大小与令人惊讶的声称相同,重复和平均(预留种子10-14,30%的毒药,100个更新,一半的声称的来源,判断判断系统的准确性0.9). 两个学习者都按该溪流的基准率进行测谎,254和257分之1 000的学得要求(差值−3-3,95%的CI−15-15至+9+9)。 选择出其不意,既不提高也不降低培训投入中的谎言份额。 在已知的谎言上,它比随机选择更糟糕。 它吸收了99.5%的申请人,而88.9%的申请人则接受了培训(开销差额+11+11分,95%的CI+9+9到13+13分),而每跑一次则接受86起索赔的培训,因为对已知事实的谎言总是令人惊讶的。 因此,对于毒药而言,意外过滤不比随机选择好,对已知事实的谎言则更糟。

blocks.en: In the same runs we also let the model answer every prompt freely (greedy decoding) and counted a claim as asserted when the answer began with its value. Under this exact-match assertion rule, the free answers are directionally consistent with the ranking metrics. The surprise-only learner stated 98% of the known-fact lies (ranking metric: 99.5%), the verifier key 14% (17%) and the full system with the evidence route 4% (8%); before learning, the model stated none of them. True new facts were stated in 71–79% of cases. Paraphrased questions were answered with the learned value less often (39–41% for new facts, 3–37% for known-fact lies), so facts learned by fine-tuning transfer weakly across wordings. Retention cannot be read this way: before learning, the model’s free answers matched the CounterFact object for only 21% of the facts it knew.
blocks.zh: 在同一段时间里,我们还让模型自由回答每分每分每分的问题(粗略地解码),并将一个索赔计算在答案开始时的价值。 根据这一精确相匹配的断言规则,自由解答的方向性与排名衡量标准一致. 仅是惊喜的学习者说98%的已知事实谎言(排名:99.5%),验证键为14%(17%),全系统有证据路线为4%(8%);在学习之前,模型没有说明其中任何一个. 71-79%的案件陈述了新的事实。 解释性的问题以较少的学习价值(新事实39–41 % 、 已知事实谎言3–37 % ) 来回答,因此通过细微调整在措辞上的转移而学到的事实。 保留不能这样读取:在学习之前,模型的自由答案只符合21 % 的事实。

blocks.en: 5.2 Lies absorbed follow the judge’s errors
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 根据法官的错误吸收谎言

blocks.en: The simulated judge in this section is not meant as a realistic model of judge behaviour. It is a controlled sensitivity analysis that isolates the effect of verifier accuracy; Section 5.8 provides the realism check with real judges. Real verifiers make mistakes, so we replaced the oracle with a simulated judge that is right with probability 0.6 to 0.9. Its errors are consistent, so a lie that fools it once always fools it. Lies absorbed then followed the judge almost one for one (Figure 3 ). The student learned nearly every lie the judge approved and very few others.
blocks.zh: 本节中模拟法官并非指法官行为的现实模式. 这是一种可控的敏感性分析,它隔离了核查者准确性的效果; 第5.8节提供了现实主义与真实判断的检查. 真正的核查者犯了错误,所以我们用一个模拟判断器取代了甲骨文,这个判断器与概率0.6到0.9是正确的. 它的错误是一致的,所以一个谎言 愚弄它 总是愚弄它。 谎言被吸收,然后几乎跟随法官为1人(图3)。 学生几乎学会了法官批准的所有谎言,其他的也很少。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Lies absorbed by the verifier key without test, against the share of lies the simulated judge approves (4 accuracies × \times 3 seeds; results/judge_sweep ).
blocks.zh: 图3:未经测试由核查器密钥所吸收的谎言,相对于模拟裁判所批准的谎言份额(4个精度×正时3个种子;结果/判断_sweep).

blocks.en: Learning of new facts also improved with judge quality (0.60 at accuracy 0.6, 0.80 at 0.9), because a weaker judge rejects more true claims. A verifier key shifts the problem to the verifier. The safety of continual learning becomes the verifier’s reliability, measured on the claims an attacker chooses.
blocks.zh: 对新事实的学习也随着法官的素质而提高(准确度为0.6,0.80为0.9),因为较弱的法官拒绝更真实的说法. 验证器密钥将问题转移给验证器. 继续学习的安全性成为核查者的可靠性,根据攻击者选择的索赔来衡量。

blocks.en: 5.3 Regression tests throttle, they do not filter
blocks.zh: 5.3 倒退试验节流阀,不过滤

blocks.en: The statistical test can detect that something went wrong, but not which claim caused it. We calibrated it on clean learning (no poison, test off). The per-chunk mean loss of preference margin on the suite ranged from − 0.72 -0.72 to + 0.78 +0.78 nats/token while retention stayed at 0.97–0.98, so we set the null drift to its 95th percentile (0.446) and the harmful effect to its standard deviation (0.203). With this calibration, rollbacks rise as the judge weakens, but the share of poison among the claims that are learned does not change (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 统计测试可以发现出事了,但不能发现是哪一种说法导致的. 我们用干净的学习来校正它(没有毒药,测试关闭)。 每吨套房的优惠差值损失从− 0.72-0.72到+ 0.78+0.78纳特/托克,而保留量则保持在0.97-0.98,因此,我们设定了无效漂移至其95%(0.446)和对其标准偏差(0.203)的有害影响。 随着这种校正,回滚随着法官的削弱而上升,但是所学的主张中毒药的比例并没有变化(表4).

blocks.en: Table 4: The calibrated test with a simulated judge at 30% poison (3 seeds; results/judge_sweep ).
blocks.zh: 表4:30%毒药的模拟判官的校正测试(3个种子;结果/裁判_sweep)。

blocks.en: A rolled-back chunk mixes accepted true claims with leaked lies, and the test discards both. It lowers lies absorbed only by learning less (at accuracy 0.7, lies fall from 0.31 to 0.20 and new facts from 0.67 to 0.40), which a smaller learning rate would also achieve. The earlier uncalibrated version, which tested the raw NLL rise with a tolerance of 0.05, was worse. It rolled back over half the chunks even with no poison and halved learning (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 一个回滚的块混合 接受真实的主张 与泄漏的谎言, 测试抛弃两者。 它只通过较少的学习吸收谎言(精确度为0.7,谎言从0.31降至0.20,新事实从0.67降至0.40),而学习率也较低。 更早的未校正版本以0.05的耐受性来测试生生的NLL上升,更糟糕. 即使没有毒药,而且学习也减少了一半(表3)。

blocks.en: We built the test as the main safety check, so this result was a disappointment, and the reason seems simple. A lie about one fact barely moves the model’s answers on unrelated facts, and our suite contained only unrelated facts. In our setting, regression testing on unrelated knowledge did not filter targeted factual poisoning. A suite built from the neighbourhood of each incoming claim, or designed to probe contradictions, might behave differently; we did not test this.
blocks.zh: 我们把测试做为主要的安全检查,因此这一结果让人失望,原因似乎很简单. 我们的套房只包含一些无关的事实。 在我们的设定中,对无关知识的回归测试没有过滤有针对性的事实中毒。 从每一项索赔的邻里建造的套房,或旨在探究矛盾的套房,其行为可能有所不同;我们没有检验这一点。

blocks.en: 5.4 The model’s own prior catches contradictions
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 模式本身以往的渔获矛盾

blocks.en: A lie about a known fact contradicts something the model already believes, and a true new fact does not. The prior-conflict key uses this difference without any judge. Added to the imperfect judge, it cut the known-fact lies the student ends up asserting by 3–5 × \times at every accuracy, so a weak judge with the prior key did better than a good judge alone (Figure 4 ). With no judge at all, the prior key held known-fact lies to 24%, against 99–100% for surprise-only learning.
blocks.zh: 一个关于已知事实的谎言与模型已经相信的东西相矛盾,而一个真正的新事实并不矛盾. 以前冲突的关键使用这种差异,而没有任何法官。 除了不完美的法官之外,它还切断了已知事实的谎言,学生最终以3–5×x\x每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分3–5分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分3–分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分3分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分 在根本没有法官的情况下,先前掌握的已知关键在于24%,而99-100%只用于惊喜学习。

blocks.en: The key has two costs. It held back 30% of true new claims in the sweep, which lowered learning of new facts from 0.60–0.79 to 0.44–0.60 depending on the judge; in a deployed system these claims would go to review rather than be lost. Retention was unchanged or slightly better (0.97–0.98). The key also cannot see lies about invented people, which were absorbed about as often with it as without it (0.35 vs. 0.41 at judge accuracy 0.6, 0.15 vs. 0.16 at 0.9), since the model holds no belief for them to contradict.
blocks.zh: 钥匙有两个成本 它在扫荡中拖回了30%真实的新索赔要求,这使得根据法官的情况,新事实的掌握从0.60-0.79降至了0.44-0.60;在一个部署的系统中,这些索赔要求将予审查而不是丢失。 保留未变或略好(0.97-0.98)。 钥匙也看不到关于被发明的人的谎言,他们被吸收的频率与没有它一样多(0.35对0.41对判断准确度0.6,0.15对0.16对0.9),因为模型不相信他们会与之相矛盾.

blocks.en: To measure the trade-off independently of the sweep, we scored 200 claims of each type on a fresh world (seed 7) under the original model. The gap separates known-fact lies from true new facts with AUC 0.83 (95% percentile bootstrap CI 0.79–0.87 from 300 resamples of single claims; resampling whole invented people with all their claims, 1,000 resamples, also gives 0.79–0.87), and lies about invented people no better than chance (AUC 0.49, CI 0.43–0.56). The operating point used in the sweep, g ≥ 6 g\geq 6 , holds back 27% of true facts and 76% of known-fact lies on this fresh world, matching the 30% cost measured in the sweep; with equal numbers of each, 74% of the claims it holds back are lies. Measured as the share of lies among the claims actually learned, the prior key lowers poison from 152 to 111 per 1,000 learned claims at judge accuracy 0.7 and from 54 to 43 at 0.9; the remaining lies are mostly about invented people, which the key cannot see.
blocks.zh: 为了独立于扫荡来衡量取舍,我们在原始模式下,在新世界(种子7)上打出200个每类索赔。 差距将已知事实与真实的新事实区分开来:AUC 0.83(95%的靴子CI 0.79-0.87从300个单项索赔的复标中分离出;将整个被发明的人及其所有索赔的复标,1000个复标,也给0.79-0.87个;关于被发明的人的谎言不比机会更好(AUC 0.49,CI 043-0.56)。 扫荡中使用的操作点 g 6 g\ geq 6 , 将27%的真实事实和76%的已知事实隐藏在这个新世界上, 与扫荡中测得的30%的成本相匹配; 与每件相同的数字, 它所持的74%的说法都是谎言. 按实际获得的权利要求中谎言的比例计算,以前的钥匙按判断准确度从每1 000人152起降至111起,以判断准确度从54起降至43起,以0.9起;其余的谎言大多涉及发明人,关键是看不到的。

blocks.en: AUC is the probability that a randomly drawn lie receives a larger gap than a randomly drawn true fact. It measures how well the gap ranks the two groups. It is not an accuracy, since the share of lies caught at a given cost depends on the threshold and is read off the curve in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: AUC是随机抽取的谎言得到比随机抽取的真实事实更大的缺口的概率. 它衡量差距对这两个团体的排名。 这不是一种准确性,因为以特定成本捕获的谎言的比例取决于阈值,并在图5中从曲线上读取。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Trade-off curve of the prior gap on the fresh seed-7 world under each original model (200 claims per type). Each point is a threshold; the diagonal is chance.
blocks.zh: 图5:每种原始模式下新鲜种子-7世界先前差距的取舍曲线(每类200项索赔)。 每个点都是阈值;对角是机会.

blocks.en: Scoring each claim by its best article variant (“nurse”, “a nurse”, …) removed template artefacts but left separation unchanged (AUC 0.83 for both rules); it only shifted the threshold. The threshold is best seen as a policy choice between safety and learning (Table 5 ). Holding back a true claim only delays it, while learning a lie corrupts the model, so we prefer an operating point on the safe side. The same threshold of 6 is used for all three models without retuning.
blocks.zh: 将每项索赔按其最佳条款变式(“护士”、“护士”......)去除模板手工艺品,但分离保持不变(两项规则均为AUC 0.83);它只是改变了门槛。 最低标准最好被视为安全与学习之间的政策选择(表5)。 隐瞒一个真实的说法只会拖延它,而学习一个谎言则会腐蚀模型,所以我们更喜欢在安全方面有一个操作点. 所有三种型号都采用相同的6分阈值而无需再调整.

blocks.en: Table 5: Safety–learning operating points of the prior key on the fresh seed-7 world with 200 claims per type. Each cell gives Qwen2.5-1.5B / Qwen2.5-3B / Llama-3.2-3B (the larger models are introduced in Section 5.7 ). The fourth column tracks the third at every threshold, so for lies about unknown entities the key holds back lies and truths at the same rate. Precision compares known-fact lies with true new facts in this balanced sample (200 of each); with fewer lies in the stream it would be lower. Person-clustered bootstrap intervals for the AUC are 0.78–0.86 (Qwen2.5-3B) and 0.74–0.82 (Llama-3.2-3B), matching the claim-level ones.

blocks.en: 5.5 A strong real judge learns only what it can verify
blocks.zh: 5.5 联合国 一个强大的真正的法官 只会学习它能验证的东西

blocks.en: With Gemini 2.5 Flash as the verifier key and a trusted source available for only half of the invented people (30% poison, verifier key without test, 3 seeds), the student absorbed 6.4% of lies, the same as before learning, and kept 98.0% of old facts. The judge approved about 2 of the roughly 170 distinct lies in each run (about 1%), and it rejected about 198 of the roughly 390 true claims, almost exactly the unsourced ones. New facts learned therefore stopped at 0.51, against 0.86 with the oracle.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5 作为验证键的闪光是仅有一半被发明的人(30%的毒药,未经检验的验证键,3个种子)可获得的可信赖的来源,学生吸收了6.4%的谎言,与学习前相同,保留了98.0%的旧事实. 法官批准了大约170起不同案件中的约2起(约1%),驳回了大约390起真实指控中的198起,几乎完全没有来源。 因此,所学出的新事实止于0.51起,而与神谕相比为0.86起。

blocks.en: Gemini rarely guessed. It rejected almost every claim it could not check against a source, so it was safe, but it learned no more than the sources covered. The harder case is a claim that is true, new and unsourced. Neither a judge nor the model’s prior can resolve it (Section 5.4 ), which motivates corroboration across independent sources as future work. Adding the statistical test changed nothing here (lies 5.8%, new facts 0.50, retention 97.8%).
blocks.zh: 双子座很少猜到. 它拒绝了几乎每一项无法对照来源的说法,因此它很安全,但只知道所覆盖的来源。 更困难的情况是,这种说法是真实的、新的和没有来源的。 无论是法官还是模式的先辈都无法解决这一问题(第5.4节),这促使独立来源之间相互确认,作为今后的工作。 加上统计测试,这里没有任何变化(5.8%,新事实0.50,保留97.8%)。

blocks.en: 5.6 Legitimate updates and the evidence route
blocks.zh: 5.6 合法更新和证据途径

blocks.en: The prior key cannot tell a lie about a known fact from true news that changes it: both contradict the model. We tested this directly by adding 100 legitimate updates to the stream: known CounterFact facts whose counterfactual value is, in this world, the new truth, each reported by a trusted source. We then added a trusted-source evidence route : a claim the prior key holds back is learned anyway if a trusted source states the same value. A planted lie has no matching source by assumption, so the route cannot readmit it. Sources were available for all claims or, in the more realistic setting, for half of them. All runs use 30% poison, the simulated judge, and five held-out seeds (10–14) that no earlier analysis used, with the gap threshold fixed at 6 before running (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 之前的密钥无法从改变它的真实消息中说出一个已知事实的谎言:两者都与模型相矛盾. 我们通过在流中添加100个合法更新来直接测试这一点:已知的"反事实"事实,其反事实价值在这个世界上是新的真相,每个事实都由一个可信赖的来源报告. 然后我们添加了一个可信赖的源证据路由 : 如果一个可信任的源表示的值相同, 则会学到先前的密钥 。 被植入的谎言通过假设没有匹配的源,因此路由无法重新发送. 所有索赔都有来源,或者在更现实的情况下,有一半的索赔都有来源。 所有跑步都使用30%的毒药,模拟裁判,以及5个未使用早期分析的被搁置种子(10-14个),差距阈值在跑出前定为6个(表6)。

blocks.en: Table 6: Legitimate updates and the evidence route. Judge accuracy 0.9, means over 5 held-out seeds; seed standard deviations are at most 0.07. At judge accuracy 0.7 the pattern is the same (updates learned 0.70 / 0.19 / 0.93 with all sources and 0.59 with half; lies per 1,000 learned claims 129–132 / 112–114 / 60 and 79).
blocks.zh: 表6:合法更新和证据途径。 判断精度为0.9,指超过5个被扣出种子;种子标准偏差最多为0.07. 法官的准确性为0.7,模式相同(所有来源的最新数据为:0.70/0.19/0.93;每1 000名有学识者中有一半为Law;129-132/112-114/60和79)。

blocks.en: The concern was real. The prior key alone blocked about three quarters of legitimate updates. The evidence route recovered them in proportion to source coverage. It rescued 192 of the 192 held-back true claims per run with full coverage and 101 of 192 with half, and it rescued no lie in any run, as the trusted-source assumption implies, because a planted lie never has a matching source. The combined system had the lowest share of poison among the claims it learned in every setting, roughly half that of the judge alone. Learning updates did cost some retention. Systems that learned most of the 100 updates kept about 5 points fewer of the untouched held-out facts (0.91–0.93 against 0.97), a side effect familiar from knowledge editing, where changing one fact disturbs its neighbours.
blocks.zh: 问题确实存在。 仅前键就屏蔽了约四分之三的合法更新. 证据路线按照来源覆盖面的比例将其收回。 它挽救了192个全覆盖的被扣回的真实索赔中的192个,192个中有101个有一半,它挽救了任何运行中的谎言,如信任的来源假设所暗示的那样,因为一个被埋设的谎言从来没有匹配的来源. 这个综合系统在每一场合所学到的声称中,毒药所占比例最低,大约只有法官的一半。 学习更新的确花费了一些时间。 在100项更新中,了解大多数更新的系统将未触及的事实(0.91-0.93对0.97)保留了约5分,这是知识编辑中熟悉的副作用,其中改变一个事实会扰乱邻国。

blocks.en: The sources in the main experiment are perfect and cannot be planted or copied. The evidence route therefore shows that legitimate updates can coexist with the prior key. It does not show that they can be trusted against an attacker who also controls sources, which is the corroboration problem of Section 8 .
blocks.zh: 主要实验中的出处是完美的,不能被植入或复制. 因此,证据路径表明,合法的更新可以与前一个密钥并存. 它没有表明他们可以被信任于一个同样控制来源的攻击者,这是第8节的佐证问题。

blocks.en: We then broke the trusted-source assumption (judge accuracy 0.9, sources for half the claims, held-out seeds 10–14). When an attacker planted a matching source for 10% of the known-fact lies, the evidence route admitted 4 lies per run and lies per 1,000 learned claims rose from 23 to 35 (paired difference + 12 +12 , 95% CI + 8 +8 to + 16 +16 ). With planted sources for 30% of the lies it admitted 18 lies per run, the model believed 29% of the known-fact lies instead of 8%, and lies per 1,000 learned claims rose to 65, worse than the judge alone in the same runs (41). When 30% of the sourced updates came with an outdated source that still stated the old value, no lie entered, but updates learned fell from 0.63 to 0.48. In short, the evidence route is as safe as its sources are hard to forge.
blocks.zh: 随后,我们打破了可信来源的假设(判断准确性0.9, 半数索赔的来源, 被搁置的种子 10-14)。 当攻击者为10%的已知事实谎言安放匹配源时,证据途径承认每跑4个谎言,每1 000个有学识的索赔从23个上升至35个(悬殊+12+12,95% CI+8+8到16+16)。 由于30%的谎言被埋入其中,每跑18个谎言,模型认为29%的已知事实谎言而不是8%,每1 000个有学识的索偿要求的谎言上升到了65个,比同一跑跑(41个)的法官更糟糕。 当30%的源代码更新带来一个仍然表示旧值的过时来源时,没有输入谎言,但学到的更新从0.63降至0.48. 简言之,证据途径如同其来源难以伪造一样安全.

blocks.en: 5.7 Replication across model size and family
blocks.zh: 5.7 模型大小和家庭的复制

blocks.en: We repeated the realistic setting of Section 5.6 (sources for half the claims, 100 legitimate updates, 30% poison, held-out seeds 10–14) with two further students, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (a larger model of the same family) and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (a different family), keeping every setting, including the gap threshold of 6, unchanged. On the fresh seed-7 world the prior gap separates known-fact lies from true new facts with AUC 0.82 (95% CI 0.78–0.86) for the 3B model against 0.83 for 1.5B, and Llama-3.2-3B reaches 0.78 (0.74–0.81); lies about invented people stay at chance for all three (0.49–0.50). The same threshold transfers without retuning: it holds back 33% (Qwen 3B) and 32% (Llama) of true facts and catches 81% and 71% of known-fact lies, against 27% and 76% for Qwen 1.5B.
blocks.zh: 我们重复了第5.6节的现实设定(一半权利主张的来源、100项合法更新、30%的毒药、被扣留的种子10-14),还有两名学生,Quen2.5-3B-Instruct(同一家庭的更大型模式)和Llama-3.2-B-Instruct(一个不同的家庭),保持每个设定,包括6个差距阈值不变。 在新鲜的种子-7世界中,先前的空隙与已知的假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假假 同样的阈值转移没有重新调整:它拖回了33%(Quen 3B)和32%(Llama)的真实事实,并捕获了81%和71%的已知事实的谎言,而Quen 1.5B为27%和76%。

blocks.en: Table 7: Replication with three students. Each cell gives Qwen2.5-1.5B / Qwen2.5-3B / Llama-3.2-3B; judge accuracy 0.9; sources for half the claims; means over 5 held-out seeds, seed standard deviations at most 0.06. Judge accuracy 0.7 shows the same pattern for all three models.
blocks.zh: 表7:与三个学生的复制. 每个单元格给出了 Quen2.5-1.5B / Quen2.5-3B / Llama-3.2-3B; 判断准确度0.9; 半数索赔的来源; 指被搁置的种子超过5个,种子标准差最多为0.06. 判官精度为0.7,所有三种型号都呈现出相同的模式.

blocks.en: Every qualitative finding replicated across both families (Table 7 ). Surprise-only learning absorbed essentially all known-fact lies. The prior key cut them roughly 2–4 × \times relative to the judge alone and left lies about invented people untouched. The evidence route recovered legitimate updates in proportion to source coverage and rescued no lie in any run, and the combined system had the lowest poison share among learned claims. Neither the larger model nor the other family made the prior key stronger, and Llama separates somewhat less sharply, with overlapping confidence intervals. For Qwen 3B, gaps grew for true new facts (median 3.8 vs. 3.2 nats/token) at least as much as for known-fact lies (8.4 vs. 8.2), so separation did not improve at this scale.
blocks.zh: 在两个家庭复制的每一项定性调查结果(表7)。 只有惊喜的学习基本上吸收了所有已知的谎言. 之前的密钥剪断了它们, 证据路线按照来源覆盖面的比例恢复了合法更新,并挽救了任何运行中的谎言,综合系统在所了解的索赔中毒性份额最低。 较大的模型或其他家族都没有使之前的钥匙更强大,而Llama的分离程度略低,信任间隔重叠. 对于Quen 3B来说,对于真实的新事实(中间3.8对3.2 nats/token)的漏洞增加,至少与已知事实的谎言(8.4对8.2)一样多,因此分离在这个尺度上没有改善.

blocks.en: 5.8 Real judges are strict and defend their own beliefs
blocks.zh: 5.8 真正的法官是严格的,捍卫自己的信仰

blocks.en: The simulated judge errs symmetrically. To see how real verifiers err, we replaced it with two local LLM judges served through Ollama: phi4 (14B, a different family from the student) and Llama 3.2 (3B, a deliberately weak judge). The setting is that of Sections 5.6 – 5.7 with the Qwen2.5-1.5B student (sources for half the claims, 100 legitimate updates, 30% poison, held-out seeds 10–14). Every verdict and prior gap was recorded per claim, about 3,300 judged claims per judge pooled over the 5 seeds; no judge answer was unparseable.
blocks.zh: 模拟法官的误差对称. 为了观察真实的验证者是如何错误的,我们用两个本地的LLM评委通过Ollama服务:phi4(14B,一个与学生不同的家庭)和Llama3.2(3B,一个故意软弱的法官)取而代之. 第5.6–5.7节的设定与Quen2.5-1.5B学生的设定(一半的诉求来源,100个合法更新,30%的毒药,被搁置的种子10-14). 每项判决和先前的缺口都记录在每件索赔中,每名法官在5个种子上集合了大约3 300起判决;没有法官无法解答。

blocks.en: Table 8: Share of claims each real judge accepted, pooled over 5 seeds.
blocks.zh: 表8:每个真正的法官接受的索赔份额,汇集了5个种子。

blocks.en: Real judges erred mostly in one direction (Table 8 ). They rarely accepted a lie, but they rejected every unsourced truth, and the weaker judge also rejected a third of sourced ones, so its weakness showed up as strictness rather than gullibility. Both judges also rejected most legitimate updates even when the trusted source was in front of them , although the prompt states that a given source is correct; the source contradicted what they believed. In this respect the judge is as conservative as the prior key, consistent with the knowledge-driven failures of LLM judges reported by Lee et al. (2026) . Verification has two separate dimensions: safety , the share of lies a verifier accepts, and coverage , the share of truths it accepts. Real judges buy high safety with low coverage, whereas the simulated judge of Section 5.2 assumed both errors were equally likely.
blocks.zh: 真正的法官主要朝一个方向出错(表8)。 他们很少接受一个谎言,但是他们拒绝了每一个没有来源的真理,而较弱的法官也拒绝了三分之一的来源的真理,因此其弱点表现为严格而非虚伪. 两位法官也都拒绝了大多数合法更新, 即使信任的消息来源在他们面前, 在这方面,法官与先前的关键一样保守,这与Lee等人(2026年)所报告的LLM法官因知识而失败的情况是一致的。 核查有两个不同的方面:安全性、核查人接受的谎言份额、其接受的真相份额。 真正的法官以低覆盖率购买高安全性,而第5.2节的模拟法官则假定这两种错误同样可能。

blocks.en: Table 9: Full systems with real judges (phi4 / Llama 3.2). Means over 5 held-out seeds; seed standard deviations at most 0.05. The evidence route rescued no lie.
blocks.zh: 表9:有真正法官的完整系统(phi4 / Llama 3.2)。 是指超过5个被搁置的种子;种子标准偏差最多为0.05. 证据路线拯救了没有谎言。

blocks.en: Because the evidence route lets a source-backed claim bypass the judge, it more than doubles the updates learned with either real judge, and the full system again holds the fewest lies among learned claims, 5–9 per 1,000 against 21–23 for the judge alone (Table 9 ). These remaining lies all entered through the judge; none entered through the evidence route.
blocks.zh: 由于证据途径让一个来源支持的诉求绕过法官,因此它比从任何一个真正的法官那里学到的更新多出一倍多,整个系统在学到的诉求中再次充斥了最少的谎言,即每1 000人中有5-9人,而仅法官就有21-23人(表9)。 其余的谎言全部通过法官输入;没有通过证据途径输入。

blocks.en: Of the 42 known-fact lies the two judges accepted, the prior key would have held back 26 (62%; 14 of 25 for phi4, 12 of 17 for Llama). Its hold rate on all known-fact lies is 77%. The 42 cases are only 28 distinct claims, because both judges saw the same worlds, so a test on the pooled cases would overstate their independence. At the seed level, the prior key’s hold rate on judge-approved lies was below its overall rate in 8 of 10 judge–seed runs (mean 65% vs. 77%; one-sided sign test over these 10 runs, p ≈ 0.05 p\approx 0.05 ). With 10 runs and 28 distinct claims, this is weak evidence, and we report it as exploratory. The observed rates suggest that the lies that fool a judge may also be somewhat harder for the prior key, so the two keys should not be assumed independent; combining them still helped in every setting.
blocks.zh: 在42个已知事实中,被接受的两名法官是谎言,先前的密钥本可以挡住26个(62%;25个中的14个是Phi4,12个是Llama17)。 它对所有已知事实的谎言的持有率为77%. 这42个案件只是28个不同的主张,因为两位法官都看到了同一个世界,因此对集合案件进行测试会过分夸大其独立性. 在种子一级,法官批准的谎言上先前的密钥持有率低于其总体比率,在10名法官中,有8名是种子跑道(平均65%对77%;在这10次跑道上进行单方面的标志测试,p- 0.05 p-约0.05)。 有10起指控和28起不同的指控,这是薄弱的证据,我们把它报告为探索性的。 观察到的费率表明,愚弄法官的谎言对先前的钥匙可能也有些更难,因此两个钥匙不应是独立的;在每一种情况下,两者的结合仍然有帮助。

blocks.en: 5.9 What the prior key detects, and how it is bypassed
blocks.zh: 5.9 (中文(简体) ). 先前的密钥检测到什么, 如何绕过

blocks.en: Section 5.4 left open whether the prior key detects lies or only contradictions. Three analyses of the saved results answer this question ( review_analyses.py ).
blocks.zh: 第5.4节对先前的密钥是否检测到谎言或只是自相矛盾没有定论。 对所节省结果的三项分析回答了这一问题(审查-分析.py.)。

blocks.en: First, the gap does not separate a lie about a known fact from a legitimate update of the same kind of fact. On the held-out runs of Section 5.8 it scores AUC 0.53 (95% CI 0.49–0.56; 424 lies, 500 updates) and holds back 77% of the lies and 75% of the updates. A second diagnostic on the fresh seed-7 world completes the four combinations of true or false and known or unknown (200 claims per type, plus 100 updates). True claims about known facts have small gaps (mean 3.2–3.5 nats/token; 17–20% held back), as do true new facts (27–33%) and lies about invented people (29–34%). Known-fact lies (71–81%) and legitimate updates (67–84%) are held back at similar rates, with AUC 0.45–0.53 between them across the three students. The gap is large whenever a claim contradicts what the model knows, whether the claim is true or false.
blocks.zh: 首先,这一空白并没有将关于已知事实的谎言同对同样事实的合法更新分开。 第5.8节暂停运行时,它得分为AUC 0.53分(95% CI 0.49–0.56;424个谎言,500个更新),并保留了77%的谎言和75%的更新。 关于新鲜种子-7世界的第二个诊断完成真实或虚假和已知或未知的四种组合(每类200项索赔,外加100项更新). 对已知事实的真实说法存在小差距(平均3.2-3.5纳特/托肯;17-20%被搁置),真实的新事实(27-33%)和关于发明人(29-34%)的谎言也是如此。 已知的谎言(71–81 %)和合法更新(67–84 %)以相近的速度被搁置,三个学生之间的AUC 0.45–0.53。 只要索赔与模型所知道的情况相矛盾,无论索赔是真实的还是虚假的,差额就很大.

blocks.en: Second, a simpler signal does as well (Table 10 ). The original model’s confidence in its own first answer token, which ignores the claim entirely, separates known-fact lies from true new facts with AUC 0.84, 0.80 and 0.88 for the three students, against 0.83, 0.82 and 0.78 for the gap. The prior gap is therefore best seen as an interpretable contradiction signal rather than a uniquely strong detector; its practical advantage is that it needs no judge call and can route suspicious claims before verification. What the prior key mostly detects, then, is that a claim touches something the model already knows.
blocks.zh: 第二,一个更简单的信号也是这样(表10)。 最初的模型对自己的第一个回答符号的信心完全忽略了这一说法,将已知事实与三个学生的AUC 0.84,0.80和0.88真实的新事实分开,而差距为0.83,0.82和0.78. 因此,以前的差距最好被看作是一个可解释的矛盾信号,而不是一个独特的强力探测器;它的实际好处是不需要法官调用,可以在核实之前处理可疑的索赔。 之前的密钥最能发现的是,一个权利要求触及到模型已经知道的东西。

blocks.en: Table 10: AUC for separating known-fact lies from true new facts on the fresh seed-7 world, by signal (200 claims per type; 95% bootstrap intervals are about ± 0.04 \pm 0.04 ).
blocks.zh: 表10:AUC将已知事实与新鲜种子-7世界的真实新事实区分开来,按信号分列(每类200项索赔;95%的靴子间隔约为±0.04\pm 0.04)。

blocks.en: Third, an attacker with access to the model can screen its lies and submit only those with a gap below 6. Only 23% of known-fact lies pass this filter, but each submitted lie then passes both keys 4.4 times as often: 11.5% instead of 2.6% with phi4, and 5.2% instead of 1.2% with Llama 3.2. Against such an attacker the prior key does not help, and safety depends on the judge alone.
blocks.zh: 第三,可以访问模型的攻击者可以筛选其谎言,并且只提交低于该模型的漏洞。 6. 国家 只有23%的已知事实谎言通过这个过滤器,但每个提交的谎言都通过4.4倍的频率:11.5%而不是2.6%的phi4,5.2%而不是1.2%的Llama3.2。 面对这种攻击者,先前的钥匙无济于事,安全仅取决于法官。

blocks.en: Paired across seeds, the evidence route lowered lies per 1,000 learned claims relative to the judge alone in all three settings of Sections 5.6 and 5.8 (95% intervals exclude zero). It cost 3–4 points of retention relative to judge + prior, and with real judges it did not significantly change the share of known-fact lies the model believes.
blocks.zh: 第5.6和5.8节的所有三种情况(95%的间隔排除为零)中,证据途径都比法官更低。 相对于法官+前法官,它花费了3–4分的留存,而对于真正的法官,它并没有显著地改变模型所相信的已知事实的比例.

blocks.en: 6 Practical implications and application scenarios
blocks.zh: 6 实际影响和应用设想

blocks.en: The setting we study is an assistant that should absorb new facts from the people it serves, such as a university, public-administration or company assistant that must follow changing regulations, responsibilities and procedures. A fact written into the weights is available in every later answer without retrieval, which is also why a wrong acceptance is costly.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究环境是一个助手,应当从所服务的人那里吸收新的事实,例如大学、公共行政或公司助理,他们必须遵守不断变化的条例、责任和程序。 在以后的每个回答中都可以找到一个写入权重的事实,而不进行检索,这也是错误的接受代价高昂的原因.

blocks.en: Retrieval ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) is the safer default for facts that change often, must be traced to a document, or may have to be removed again. Parametric updates are worth their risk for stable facts that are used constantly, or where retrieval is unavailable. In both designs the acceptance decision studied here remains: a poisoned document store misleads the model as a poisoned stream does.
blocks.zh: 检索(Lewis等,2020年)是对经常改变,必须追溯到文件,或者可能必须再去除的事实的更安全的默认. 对于经常使用或无法检索的稳定事实,参数更新值其风险。 在两种设计中,在此研究的验收决定仍然存在:一被中毒的文件商店误导了模型,就像一被中毒的溪流那样.

blocks.en: Our results suggest four. (1) Never select what to learn by surprise alone. (2) Use a verifier key, and measure its safety and its coverage separately on the claims it will actually see. (3) Use the prior key as a cheap triage filter that sends conflicting claims to evidence or review. It does not stop an attacker with access to the model, who can bypass it. (4) Accept contradicting claims only with evidence from sources whose integrity is controlled independently of the claim’s author; with planted sources for 30% of the lies, the evidence route made the system worse than the judge alone (Section 5.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示4个。 (1) 永远不要独自选择什么值得意外学习。 (2) 使用核实器的钥匙,并根据它实际看到的索赔分别衡量其安全性和覆盖范围。 (3)使用前键作为廉价的分解过滤器,将相冲突的权利要求发送给证据或审查. 它不会阻止攻击者接触模型,谁可以绕过模型. (4) 仅以独立于提交人的正直性受到控制的来源的证据来接受相互矛盾的指控;由于30%的谎言都来自人所编造的来源,证据途径使系统比法官本身更糟糕(第5.6节)。

blocks.en: With the prior key in front of the judge, judge calls fell from about 661 to 374 per run ( − 43 % -43\% ). The reduction concerns judge calls, not total verification cost: about 180 claims per run stayed held back even with the evidence route and move to a review queue whose cost we did not measure. Learning updates cost 3–4 points of retention on untouched facts. A deployment has to weigh these costs against the cost of a single absorbed lie.
blocks.zh: 由于法官面前的钥匙,法官的电话从每次约661次减少到374次(-43%-43%)。 减少费用涉及法官打电话,而不是总的核查费用:即使有证据,每批约180件索赔仍被搁置,并转入审查队,而我们没有计算费用。 学习更新花费了3–4分 保留未改变的事实。 部署时必须权衡这些费用与一个被吸收的谎言的费用。

blocks.en: How to establish that a source is trustworthy, how to handle sources that disagree or are outdated, how to make review cheap, and whether many small updates eventually harm knowledge more than they help.
blocks.zh: 如何确定一个来源是值得信赖的,如何处理有不同意见或已经过时的来源,如何使审查变得便宜,以及许多小更新最终是否对知识的伤害大于帮助.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Two limitations matter most.
blocks.zh: 两个限制最重要。

blocks.en: True news that changes something the model already knew (a new office holder, say) contradicts its prior just as a lie does; the prior key held back about three quarters of such updates in Section 5.6 . On its own, the key cannot tell an update from a lie. In a continual learner this case is common. Held-back claims need a second route. Section 5.6 tests one, an evidence check against a trusted source; it works with perfect sources and fails once an attacker can plant them. The prior is also not ground truth: where pretraining taught the model something false, the prior key defends the error and holds back its correction. We therefore read the prior key as a triage filter that routes conflicting claims to evidence or review.

blocks.en: Our poison is fixed in advance. We did not test attackers who also target the judge. Our numbers describe these attackers only and give no safety guarantee.

blocks.en: • Small models only. Main results use Qwen2.5-1.5B; the key comparisons are repeated on Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B (Section 5.7 ), and neither strengthened the prior key. Models larger than 3B parameters were not tested. The study is designed to establish the mechanism in small, reproducible models; larger models are future work. • Short factual claims. Claims are single subject–relation–object facts. Instructions, opinions and multi-hop knowledge are not covered. • Limited judge coverage. The simulated judge errs symmetrically; the real judges of Section 5.8 erred mostly by rejecting truths, and the lies they did accept were partly ones the prior key also misses. Two local judges and one API judge are a small sample of verifiers. An attacker would search for those claims, so the relevant measure is a judge’s accuracy on adversarially chosen poison rather than its average accuracy. • Unmeasured review load. We did not measure what it costs to review the claims the prior key holds back, by people or by retrieval; the 27% of true claims held back is a lower bound once legitimate updates are included. • Template artefacts. Some held-back true facts arise from templates (for example, “The profession of X is” strongly favours an answer beginning with “a …”). Scoring the best of article variants moved the threshold but left separation unchanged (AUC 0.83 either way). • Threshold choice. The rule and the threshold g ≥ 6 g\geq 6 were developed on a 30-claim sample of the seed-0 world, which the prior sweep of Section 5.4 also uses. The seed-7 diagnostic and seeds 10–14 were run afterwards with the threshold fixed, and it transferred unchanged to two further models. The threshold also transfers unchanged across these settings. A test set untouched by any development choice would still be stronger evidence. • Paraphrase transfer is weak. Facts learned in one wording are recalled in other wordings less often (0.62 vs. 0.86 with the oracle verifier key at 30% poison), a known limit of fact injection by fine-tuning. • No retrieval baseline, limited open-ended evaluation. We did not compare with a retrieval system on the same stream; the question studied here is the acceptance decision for parametric learning, and retrieval changes the storage mechanism, so it calls for a separate baseline. Open-ended answers (Section 5.1 ) were checked in one setting and only as single greedy answers; multi-step questions and longer documents remain untested. • Scale of compute. We used three seeds per setting in Sections 5.1 – 5.5 and five in Sections 5.6 – 5.8 , all on a laptop GPU. Bootstrap confidence intervals are reported for the prior-key AUC (Section 5.4 ), seed standard deviations under each table, and per-seed results in the released results folders.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion and future work
blocks.zh: 8 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: A false claim that contradicts a known fact is highly surprising to the model by construction, so selecting by surprise lets such lies through. In our controlled poisoned streams, a surprise-driven learner absorbed up to 93% of the lies it saw, and 99–100% of the known-fact lies. A verifier key removed them, but the learner then inherited the errors of its judge. Regression tests on unrelated knowledge did not help in our setting, because a lie barely affects other facts. The model’s own prior is a cheap second key that needs no judge and saves judge calls. It cuts absorbed known-fact lies 2.5–5 × \times with simulated judges and 1.5–2.5 × \times with real ones, at the price of sending about a quarter of true claims to review, but it reacts to any contradiction with what the model knows, true or false, and an attacker with access to the model can avoid it. None of the signals we study decides truth on its own, and our results suggest that a safer continual learner should combine complementary signals rather than rely on any one of them (Table 11 ). The real-judge results add a further constraint. They rarely accepted lies, but they also rejected most legitimate updates with a trusted source in view, so source-backed claims need a route that bypasses the judge.

blocks.en: In controlled streams with three students of 1.5–3B parameters: surprise-driven selection absorbs most lies and nearly all known-fact lies, takes in lies at the same rate as random selection with the same budget, and absorbs known-fact lies more reliably than random selection does; a verifier key’s safety follows its judge; regression tests on unrelated facts throttle learning without filtering lies; the prior gap separates known-fact lies from true new facts (AUC 0.78–0.83) but neither lies about invented people (0.49–0.50) nor lies from legitimate updates (0.53), and the model’s answer confidence does as well; an attacker who screens lies with the model passes it; and with trusted sources, the evidence route recovers held-back updates while no lie enters through it, but planted sources for 30% of the lies make the system worse than the judge alone. Open-ended answers, under an exact-match assertion rule, are directionally consistent with the ranking metrics.

blocks.en: That these findings hold for larger models, adaptive attackers and sources an attacker can plant; and that corroboration across independent chains, proposed below, can resolve unsourced claims about unknown entities.

blocks.en: None of the keys in this study resolves the case of a new, unsourced claim about something the model has never seen. The judge refuses it, and the prior has nothing to contradict (AUC 0.49). We see four directions for future work. 1. Legitimate updates of known facts. True news that changes something the model knew contradicts its prior just as a lie does. Section 5.6 shows that routing held-back claims to an evidence check recovers them when sources are perfect, and that planted sources for 30% of the lies make it worse than the judge alone. An important next step is a defence against planted and copied sources, and real retrieval instead of a simulated source. 2. Corroboration. Accept unsourced claims only after independent confirmations; a liar is usually one source, the truth many. Corroboration should count independent chains of transmission rather than sources, since copies add no evidence; this is the criterion of the mutawatir report in hadith scholarship, which accepts a report only when so many independent chains carry it that collusion on a falsehood is implausible. Raja (2026) adapts related hadith methods to provenance in multi-agent knowledge systems; we propose applying the independence criterion to what may be written into the weights. New claims could wait in an erasable memory with provenance until enough independent chains arrive, and only then be consolidated into the weights. This turns the acceptance decision into a sequential test on independent evidence, where SPRT is the natural tool. 3. Adversarial verifiers and attackers. Measure judge accuracy on poison chosen to fool it, and attackers who adapt to the prior key (for example, lies phrased to sit close to the model’s own answer). 4. Breadth. Other model sizes and families, more seeds, claim types beyond single facts (instructions, procedures, multi-hop knowledge), and consolidation of committed adapters into the base (“sleep”) with the prior key anchored to the pre-learning model.
blocks.zh: 本研究的钥匙中没有一个能解决关于模型从未见过的新而无来源的主张的情况. 法官对此予以拒绝,且前款并无相矛盾之处(AUC 0.39). 我们看到今后的工作有四个方向。 1. 对已知事实的合法更新。 真正的消息是,改变模型知道的东西 与它的前言相矛盾 就像一个谎言一样。 第5.6节表明,在证据核实的路线要求中,当来源完美时,可以收回这些内容,而30%的谎言的播种来源使其比法官本身更糟糕。 下一个重要步骤是防范被埋设和复制的源,以及真正的检索而不是模拟的源. 2. 认证。 只有在独立确认后才接受未来源的主张;骗子通常是一个来源,真理很多. 校正应算独立传输链而不是来源,因为副本不增加任何证据;这是Hadith奖学金中的变异报告的标准,只有在如此多的独立链条携带报告时,才会接受报告,以致于串通谎言是不可信的。 拉贾(2026年)将相关的hadith方法适用于多代理知识系统中的出处;我们提议将独立标准应用于可能写入权重的内容. 新的权利主张可以等到具有出处的可去除的内存中,直到足够独立的链子到达,然后才被整合入权重. 这使得接受决定变成了独立证据的相继测试,其中SPRT是自然工具. 3. 核查者和攻击者。 量度判断所选择的欺骗它的毒药的准确性,以及适应之前的密钥的攻击者(例如,用词是接近模型本身的答案). 4. 面包。 其他模型大小和家庭、更多的种子、超出单一事实的主张类型(指示、程序、多跳知识),以及将承诺的适配器并入基础(“睡眠”),前一个键固定在学习前模型上。

blocks.en: Legitimate updates of known facts. True news that changes something the model knew contradicts its prior just as a lie does. Section 5.6 shows that routing held-back claims to an evidence check recovers them when sources are perfect, and that planted sources for 30% of the lies make it worse than the judge alone. An important next step is a defence against planted and copied sources, and real retrieval instead of a simulated source.

blocks.en: Corroboration. Accept unsourced claims only after independent confirmations; a liar is usually one source, the truth many. Corroboration should count independent chains of transmission rather than sources, since copies add no evidence; this is the criterion of the mutawatir report in hadith scholarship, which accepts a report only when so many independent chains carry it that collusion on a falsehood is implausible. Raja (2026) adapts related hadith methods to provenance in multi-agent knowledge systems; we propose applying the independence criterion to what may be written into the weights. New claims could wait in an erasable memory with provenance until enough independent chains arrive, and only then be consolidated into the weights. This turns the acceptance decision into a sequential test on independent evidence, where SPRT is the natural tool.

blocks.en: Decoding used temperature 0, at most 20 output tokens and a thinking budget of 0 for Gemini, and at most 10 tokens for the Ollama judges. The first standalone “true” or “false” in the answer is the verdict. The simulated judge is correct with probability equal to its accuracy, decided by a hash of the seed, claim identifier and value, so the same claim always receives the same verdict within a seed.
blocks.zh: 解码使用温度为0,最多20个输出符和双子座的思维预算为0,奥拉马评委最多10个. 答复中的第一个独立的“真实”或“虚假”是判决。 模拟判断的概率与其准确性相当是正确的,由种子的散列,索赔标识和价值决定,所以同一索赔总是在种子内得到相同的判断.
